items.text: Can we do an audit for all the components. I wanted fluid components that feels modern and responsive. can you look at the research and components that has been done in ~/projects/leetcoach . please launch an audit to review each component. i think it's better to have a well tested component, rather than creating it ourselves from scratch. launch opus workflow

Also, I dont think the seen reviewed pages is tracked properly. i only see 0/12 reviewed. i wanna see which files already seen. we also do not have the search feature i wanted. can you look back at the previous comments i made in prev snapshot? please do adversarial review, to make sure we dont miss anything important. use opus workflow
for the facts here, can we also list down the components, and facts about each of them? so i can review them in more detail?
